availability.note: BYD AU configurator (bydautomotive.com.au/configurator/dolphin 301s here) lists exactly two grades, Essential and Premium; TheDriven (Sep 2026) confirms two variants. CarsGuide's 2026 price list still carries a Dynamic at $36,890, which CarExpert's review says was discontinued when Essential arrived.

listPrice.note: Configurator shows $29,990 beside the grade with drive-away estimated separately by postcode; TheDriven (20 Sep 2026) gives $29,990 'before on-road costs' in words; CarsGuide 2026 MSRP agrees and 'excludes stamp duty, other government charges'. The configurator's $28,888 'Driveaway Campaign' (NSW delivery, orders 15 Sep-15 Dec 2026, delivered by 31 Dec) is a campaign and ignored.

batteryKwh.note: EV Database UK, Dolphin 44.9 kWh Active (same 70kW FWD pack): nominal 46.0, usable 44.9. AU brochure prints 44.9 unlabelled.

rangeKm.note: AU brochure '*Electric range: WLTP Combined Cycle (km) 340' (NEDC 410 alongside, rejected). EV Database UK Active: WLTP 211 mi = 340 km, same pack and 70kW motor; AU Essential on 195/60 R16.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: EV Database WLTP rated consumption 245 Wh/mi = 15.2 kWh/100km (includes charging losses; battery/range gives 13.2).

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: AU brochure 'Luggage capacity - Min (L) 345'; measurement method not stated, assumed to the cargo cover. CarExpert also 345L.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: AU brochure 'Luggage capacity - Max (L) 1,310'; method not stated and likely to the roof rather than the belt line, so may overstate the cover convention. No review gives a to-the-belt-line figure.

towKg.note: EV Database: braked towing 0 kg, 'Tow Hitch Possible: No'. AU brochure lists no towing capacity; CarsGuide spec shows a dash for braked trailer weight.

warrantyYears.note: CarExpert: 6 years/150,000km vehicle; battery 8 years/160,000km. CarsGuide 2026 Essential page agrees.

depreciationCurve.note: BYD brand convention used by Atto 1/2, Seal 6, Sealion 5/6/7 and Shark 6 (one curve per brand). byd-atto3 refreshed today on a steeper curve; flagged for the orchestrator. Repeated Dolphin campaigns (Sep 2026 $28,888 drive-away) are the kind of evidence the brand curve already reflects.
